items.title: Desert Temple
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
What treasures lie in the mysterious pyramid? Explore the mysteries of the temple or settle at a nearby campsite. Adventure through the bustling streets of the surrounding towns and parkour across rooftops as you get ready for the exciting journey ahead!

- Multiple towns with fully decorated houses
- Hidden treasure around the map
- Perfect for roleplay with friends

items.title: Fading Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Why wear one color when you can wear many? With this amazing pack of gradient-style outfits to choose from, you'll find the perfect combination to use and stand out among your friends.

+ 10 amazing skins
+ By iRay

items.title: Biome Buddies
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Everyone has their own favorite biomes in Minecraft, but now you can show off your favorite with the Biome Buddies pack!

+ 10 bombastic biomes
+ Diverse and wide range of choices!
+ By thiccsnail

items.title: Purple Style
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Fancy purple skins! Wear the cutest outfits of your dreams in sparkling purple and play your favorite games like skyblock and parkour in style!

+ Perfect for PvP
+ 1 free skin
+ by Blockline

items.title: Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Lucky blocks are blocks that have random outcomes. If you’re lucky, break a lucky block and get diamonds!

items.title: Street Moe Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Street moe styles are in town! Wait what? You don't know what moe means? Uh, let's just say it means cute and lovely... Yeah! Street Moe Teens!

+ 13 roleplay skins!
+ Street attire inspired by street artists!

items.title: State Alchemist
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Alchemists specialize in all sorts of unique and interesting chemical reactions. What will you specialize in the vast world of alchemy?

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Adventurous attire inspired by alchemy!

items.title: Halloween Costumes
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description: Halloween's here and it's time to pick the spookiest, scariest, creepiest outfit. It's about time to pick a treat this Halloween!

items.title: Pumpkin Roleplay
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Do you prefer your pumpkins with armor or without? Get yourself into a spooky orange mood with the Pumpkin Roleplay skin pack - whether it's armor, a skeleton, or a country punkin, you can be any kind you like!

- 10 spooky skins included!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Ghostly 2
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to get spooky. Haunt your friends and pop out of the walls with the Ghostly 2 skin pack, where ghosts are in and zombies are out! Maybe you could even scare the mobs...

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Glitched Digital Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
There's a glitch in the system! Can you fix the mobs? Well, why bother when they look this good! Pick your favorite and make your way through the hacks with the Glitched Digital Mobs skin pack.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Horror Movie Heads
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
The best thing you can do during Halloween is to watch a scary movie... so why not become a portable one? Pick your favorite spooky scene and wear it around the mines with the Horror Movie Screen Heads skin pack, where scary just got real.

- 10 spooky skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Twisted Vines
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Why decorate your garden when you can decorate yourself? Let the twisting vines navigate themselves around your skin! Pick the best mob with the most beautiful vines and blend in with the forests around you. Zombies have never looked so good.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Creepy
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
What's that in the distance? Something's walking towards us. It's kind of creepy. Go for classic horror with the Creepy skin pack, dress up for Halloween, and come over the hill and into your friends' houses with scariness! Why not give them a fright?

- 10 scary skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Ender Shades 2
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to take the End and mix things up a little! Pick some different shades with the Ender Shades 2 skin pack and show those mobs who can be the scariest. Show off for the spooky holidays and be the scariest you can be!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Infected Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Something's wrong with the mobs, can you figure out what it is in time? Or will you join them instead? With the Infected Mobs skin pack, scare your friends into the deep, dark mines. Spread the mystery and watch them descend into spooky new territory!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Skeleton Gamers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Rattle, rattle, beep beep! It's time to combine the two scariest things in the world: skeletons and... gamers! Fit in with the scary squad and collect diamonds at the same time with the Skeleton Gamers skin pack!

- 10 skins (one skin free - enjoy!)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Demon Masks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to rise up from the ground and become scarier than the creepers... Put on your Demon Mask and scare your friends, make the mobs too fearful to come near you, and spook those carrots into growing faster!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Halloween Emojis
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Scare your friends with the spookiest faces known to mankind - the Halloween Emojis! Knock on the doors to caves, go bother some creepers for a sweet, and go trick or treating in the End with your friends. Which costume is your favorite?

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Creepy Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Is it Halloween already? No? Well, you sure do look creepy. Dress up as a Creepy Mob and take your time to haunt your way through the caves. It's too easy to scare even the weirdest mob now...

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Teen Sea Divers
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Sink to the bottom of the ocean and explore depths unknown to the Minecraft worlds with these aquatic teen diver skins!

items.title: Camo Blocks: Survival
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Be the ultimate survival ninja and hide from your friends with this camouflage set!

- 8 classic block camos!
- Includes: Sugar Cane, Dark Oak Tree, Birch Tree, Tall Grass, Stone, Oak Tree, Rose Bush, Sand and Water

items.title: Jurassic Pets
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Want some little friends? Cute, little dinosaur pets are waiting to be your buddies! Explore the world and collect all Jurassic Pets! Feed them, go on a walk or let them rest in a cute dino bed! 

+ 140+ Dinosaur variants!
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ World with custom textures!
+ Works in Creative & Survival

items.title: Lucky Blocks Adventure
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
In this little taiga village, the luck is on your side! Destroy the Lucky Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios
